china-1925-6:p1122_2.rationale: Compares ocean-going steamer tonnage at Shanghai with gross import and export trade value, giving a ratio by year. Shipping and port traffic are the main subject, with trade values as the comparison.

china-1925-6:p1123_1.rationale: Gives average tonnage per ocean-going steamer calling at Shanghai by year, which is shipping traffic at a port.

china-1925-6:p1129_1.rationale: Lists coast and river steamers by owning company, with build year and gross register tonnage. This is a fleet inventory.

china-1925-6:p1130_1.rationale: Continues the fleet list of one company's steamers, with build year and gross tonnage.

china-1925-6:p1131_1.rationale: Continues the China Navigation Co. steamer list, with build year and gross register tonnage.

china-1925-6:p1131_2.rationale: Lists the steamers of the Chinese Engineering and Mining Co., with build year, tonnage and flag. This is a merchant fleet inventory.

china-1925-6:p1131_3.rationale: Lists the steamers of the Chinese Government Steamship Administration and Ching Kee S. N. Co., with build year and tonnage.

china-1925-6:p1132_1.rationale: A multi-page inventory of coast and river steamers grouped by owning company, with build year and gross register tonnage.

china-1925-6:p1139_1.rationale: Counts inland waters steam vessels registered at each port from 1919 to 1923, with new registrations, withdrawals and flag breakdowns.

china-1925-6:p1140_1.rationale: Gives vessels entered and cleared at Chinese ports by flag and type, with numbers and tonnage for 1919 to 1923.
